name: Agent Usage Report
description: Read Agent platform usage data with an administrator account and generate an HTML usage report grouped by business scenario.
configuration.api_base_url.label: Platform API URL
configuration.api_base_url.description: Poco backend API URL ending with /api/v1, for example http://10.6.77.110:8000/api/v1
authorization.title: Authorize with an administrator account
authorization.description: Enter the username and password of a platform administrator. Authorization signs in and verifies the administrator role; non-administrator accounts are rejected. Only accounts with a password are supported; SSO-only accounts must set a password first.
authorization.username.label: Administrator username
authorization.username.description: Platform sign-in username; the account role must be admin or super admin
authorization.password.label: Password
authorization.password.description: Platform sign-in password, stored encrypted by POCO
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.dataset.title: Read usage data
capabilities.dataset.description: Read runs, outcomes, cost, tokens, users and departments for a date range, plus titles and AI summaries of scheduled tasks, chats and API sessions.
capabilities.report.title: Generate a report
capabilities.report.description: Classify actual work by business domain and deliverable, and produce an HTML report with conclusions, cost drivers, scheduled task health, department adoption and recommendations.
limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Up to 31 days per analysis, using Beijing time. Users with content privacy enabled are counted in numbers only; their session titles and summaries are hidden. Read-only; nothing on the platform is modified.
examples.title: Examples
examples.week.title: This week
examples.week.description: Analyze this week's Agent platform usage and generate a report.
examples.day.title: Daily report
examples.day.description: Create an Agent usage report for yesterday.
